name: Colorectal cancer screening
frequency: Colonoscopy every 10 years, FIT annually, or other USPSTF-accepted strategy
note: USPSTF: Grade B ages 45–49, Grade A ages 50–75. Average-risk adults.

name: Mammogram
note: USPSTF Grade B (2024): biennial screening mammography for women 40–74.

name: Cervical cancer screening
frequency: Pap every 3 years (21–29); Pap, hrHPV, or co-test every 3–5 years (30–65)
note: USPSTF Grade A. Stops at 65 with adequate prior screening history.

name: Lung cancer screening (low-dose CT)
note: USPSTF Grade B: ages 50–80 with 20+ pack-year history who currently smoke or quit within 15 years.

name: BRCA-related cancer risk assessment
note: USPSTF Grade B: brief familial risk assessment if personal/family history of breast, ovarian, tubal, or peritoneal cancer (or BRCA-associated ancestry).

name: Blood pressure screening
frequency: At regular intervals; confirm abnormal readings outside the office
note: USPSTF Grade A: screen adults 18+ for hypertension with office blood pressure measurement.

name: Abdominal aortic aneurysm ultrasound
note: USPSTF Grade B: one-time ultrasound for men 65–75 who have ever smoked.

name: Prediabetes and type 2 diabetes screening
frequency: Every 3 years if normal; more often if prediabetes
note: USPSTF Grade B: ages 35–70 with overweight or obesity. Confirm weight status with your clinician.

name: Depression screening
frequency: When systems are in place for diagnosis and follow-up
note: USPSTF Grade B: screen adults, including older adults, for depression.

name: Anxiety screening
frequency: When systems are in place for diagnosis and follow-up
note: USPSTF Grade B: screen adults 64 or younger for anxiety disorders.

name: Hepatitis C screening
note: USPSTF Grade B: one-time HCV screening for adults 18–79.

name: HIV screening
frequency: At least once; more often if at increased risk
note: USPSTF Grade A: screen adolescents and adults 15–65 for HIV.

name: Osteoporosis screening (DEXA)
note: USPSTF Grade B: screen women 65+ for osteoporosis to prevent fractures.

name: Unhealthy alcohol use screening
frequency: In primary care; counsel if risky use
note: USPSTF Grade B: screen adults 18+ for unhealthy alcohol use and offer brief counseling when indicated.

name: Unhealthy drug use screening
frequency: Ask about use when follow-up care is available
note: USPSTF Grade B: screen adults 18+ by asking about unhealthy drug use (not biologic testing).

name: Tobacco cessation support
frequency: Ask every visit; treat if using tobacco
note: USPSTF Grade A: ask about tobacco use and offer behavioral interventions and FDA-approved pharmacotherapy for cessation.
